masterOn.message: Features below are applied to the web player.

masterOff.message: Everything is off: the web player works as usual.

playcountsDesc.message: A play count for each song, as in the desktop app.

likedSongsDesc.message: How many of the artist's songs you liked, with the list. Keeps a local index of your liked songs.

playlistToolsTitle.message: Search and sort in playlists and albums

playlistToolsDesc.message: Search in playlist and sort by, in playlists and Liked Songs. Albums can also be sorted by plays.

debugDesc.message: Logs the web player's internal requests to the page console. Reload the Spotify tab after changing it.

disclaimer.message: Unofficial project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Spotify.
